messages:
Ash: Heads-up — metrics-explorer canary in eu-west is slow. Chart paints are ~800–1200ms on first load (normally ~120ms).
Maria: Which canary? build/sha?
Ash: Deployed at 2026-03-19T09:12Z, build 6482 (sha abcdef). See deploy-bot message.
deploy-bot: deploy canary 6482 to eu-west at 2026-03-19T09:12Z — sha: abcdef — status: success
Ryan: I captured a trace — each widget requests a "viz-runtime" chunk that's not cacheable. Browser ends up downloading the same 220KB gz chunk multiple times on first load.
Ash: Yeah seeing multiple downloads per panel in devtools waterfall.
Eva: Can reproduce with 3x widgets locally when throttling network. Looks like the runtime is instantiated per mount.
Sachin: FYI the telemetry lib added on 3/18 does a sync init that reads window.locale and attaches some globals — blocks main thread ~150ms.
Maria: Any changes to chunk naming or bundler around 3/18?
Ryan: Build 6482 changed chunk naming to include variant flags. Canary enabled a "telemetry-opt" variant so viz-runtime filename is different per route -> cache misses across routes.
Ash: So root causes: chunk duplication (cache misses) + telemetry sync init blocking. Short-term fixes?
Eva: Quick moves: rollback the variant flag in CDN (stop generating route-specific names) and fix cache-control headers to be 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' for hashed chunks. Plus defer telemetry init.
Sachin: I can open a hotfix PR to make telemetry init async and respect a canary opt-out flag (window.__REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_DISABLED). Will patch today.
Maria: Also audit edge config — some assets accidentally set 'cache-control: private, max-age=0'. That's likely why clients revalidated.
Ryan: For visibility, I'll add two lightweight RUM metrics: chart-paint-ms and chunk-download-count for the dashboard route so we can measure impact live.
Ash: Plan: (1) PR for async telemetry (sachin), (2) CDN header fix / variant rollback (eva), (3) add RUM metrics (ryan). Rollout: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with manual pauses.
Eva: I'll schedule the CDN rollback at 11:00 UTC and coordinate the canary throttles.
Ash: :thumbsup: I'll monitor RUM and post before/after traces here at 11:10. If median chart paint drops by ~50%, we continue.
deploy-bot: PR #4229 merged by sachin — telemetry init deferred. CDN rule rollback queued by eva for 11:00 UTC.
Maria: Filing follow-up to ensure deterministic chunk naming and to add a pre-deploy check for cache-control on hashed assets. I'll create the ticket.
